title: Slack Desktop data
whyItMatters: Slack caches workspace messages, tokens and uploads. It reveals which teams the user belonged to and what was shared there.
notes: Sandboxed installs use ~/Library/Containers/com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap/Data/Library/Application Support/Slack instead. Cookies and IndexedDB are not read.

cleanup.exportFirst: Download the files you posted or still need from Slack, because the cached copies on this Mac are removed.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of every workspace from Slack's own menu, so those workspaces stop trusting this Mac.
steps: Quit Slack so its cached files are not in use.
Move Slack to the Trash from Applications and empty the Trash.
Delete the Slack folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Cached messages, session tokens and uploads for the signed-in workspaces leave this Mac.
